mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agreement_tbl (user_id, agreement_id, agreed_at, agreed_yn) SELECT #{userId}, a.agreement_id, NOW(), 'Y' FROM agreement_tbl a WHERE a.agreement_type = 'CHECK_CARD' AND a.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: select agreement_id, agreement_name , agreement_content from agreement_tbl where agreement_type = 'CHECK_CARD'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(a.agreement_id) = SUM(CASE WHEN b.agreement_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_all_agreed FROM agreement_tbl a LEFT JOIN user_agreement_tbl b ON a.agreement_id = b.agreement_id AND b.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.agreement_type = 'CHECK_CARD' AND a.required_yn = 'Y' AND a.use_yn = 'Y';
select * from custom_card_tbl where user_id = #{userId} and custom_card_id = #{customCardId};
select custom_card_image_name from custom_card_image_tbl where custom_card_id = #{customCardId};
